football_factors.name: QB Efficiency

football_factors.name: Turnover Edge
football_factors.reason: CAR wins the turnover battle slightly — a 0.09 turnover-per-game edge that creates shorter fields and extra possessions.

football_factors.name: Offensive Efficiency
football_factors.reason: TB's offense generates modestly more expected points per play than CAR's (0.116 EPA/play difference), keeping drives alive and converting more consistently.

football_factors.name: Defensive Resistance
football_factors.reason: TB's defense is slightly more stingy than CAR's — allowing 0.049 fewer EPA per play and limiting opponent scoring opportunities.

football_factors.name: Pressure Matchup
football_factors.reason: CAR wins the pass rush vs. protection battle slightly (0.020 sack-rate edge) — a mismatch that can collapse key third-down drives.
